03.02.2026 WPSB No.46 of 2026
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel for the 
petitioner through V.C.
2. Mr. J. C. Pandey and Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, 
learned Standing Counsel for the State/respondent 
no.1.
3. Issue notice to respondent nos.2 & 3. 
4. Steps to be taken within three days. 
5. By means of the present writ petition, the 
petitioner has sought quashing of the orders dated 
16.01.2026 and 09.12.2025, as well as the 
advertisement dated 20.01.2026.
6. The petition was listed yesterday, and learned 
counsel for the State had sought time to obtain 
instructions. Today, on instructions from the Secretary, 
P.W.D., State of Uttarakhand, learned counsel for the 
State seeks three weeks’ time to file a counter affidavit 
and states that, in the meantime, no appointment shall 
be made pursuant to the aforesaid advertisement.
7. In view of the above, let the counter affidavit be 
filed within three weeks.
8. List on 24.02.2026 after fresh matters. 
9. Urgency application (IA No.2 of 2026) is 
allowed. 
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.)
 Vacation Judge
